[attribute-document-id-type]
=== `@document-id-type` Related Object Document Identifier Type

Type of document identifier (for example, a DOI or a publisher’s identifier) named in the <<attribute-document-id,`@document-id`>> attribute of the <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>> element to identify a document.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| The type of document identifier of the related object, for example, a DOI| The type of document identifier named in the <<attribute-document-id,`@document-id`>> attribute for a (<<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>) element. This attribute qualifies the <<attribute-document-id,`@document-id`>> attribute.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
